text: Hey Boaz - it's very possible that your partner received a digital extension, including of the intervisa (which will enable them to travel abroad and return). You can check whether they meet the criteria on our website here: https://aic.org.il/digital-visa-extension-round-march-2026/ If your partner has an extension, the new expiry date will be three months from the date of the original expiry. Regarding the rescheduling, we don't yet know whether PIBA is prioritising status upgrades - however, this is something that AIC has been advocating for :)
